A '''negotiator''' working on behalf of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to form ties with the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] around [[3640 BBY]]. Though the murder was orchestrated by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] diplomat [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Torius]], the negotiator's death was officially attributed to an attack by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] species.
